svg.text: The delay() trap: button presses that go unheard
The same five button presses, two ways to write an LED blink · a 6-second timeline
0 of 5 presses recorded: the button is only glanced at when the ESP32 wakes up briefly every 2 seconds.
loop() runs tens of thousands of times per second
each thin line = one pass of loop(): "is it time yet?" then check the button
5 of 5 presses recorded: nothing falls asleep, so the button is checked all the time.
